findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed an employees operate the faucet handles of the handsink with bare hands after the handwashing process. Discussed proper handwashing procedures with the PIC. Ensure that a paper towel is used to operate faucet handles after the handwashing process to prevent recontaminating freshly washed hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed dried food debris on the inner surfaces of both microwaves (in the self service station area). Discussed with person-in-charge (PIC). Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces of equipment are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
A tuna sandwich was observed exceeding its use by date. The use by date was 3/11/2024. Discussed with PIC and the sand which was pulled and discarded. Ensure that TCS foods are used or discarded prior to the expiration date. 

3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time. 

1) A 1 gallon container of milk has a use by date of 11/29/23 (yesterday). 2) Multiple individual containers of milk are observed with used by/sell by dates of 11/28/23 or earlier. All of the items were discarded by the PIC during this inspection to correct the violations. Ensure that TCS foods are used or discarded prior to their expiration dates.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

1) There is a section of wall between the back door and the mop sink (at the floor) that is in need of repair. 2) There are broken coving tiles in the corner behind the soda syrups. Repair both locations prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
Antifreeze and motor oil were observed next to salt and canned food, and were stored above disposable paper towels. These chemicals must be stored away from food and single service articles. The storage of these chemicals directly above or adjacent to food could result in contamination of the food from spillage. Ensure the food or chemicals are moved so they are stored separately with no risk of contamination.
 
7-201.11: (A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed the ice dispensers and a few soda nozzles on the soda dispenser to be soiled with mold, mildew, and other debris. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned frequently so they are clean to sight and touch. 

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the mop to be stored inside old mop water in the mop bucket. Ensure the mop is placed in a position that allows it to air dry and old mop water is discarded. The mop was moved in an approved position by the inspector during the inspection. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: 2-102.12: The manager working during the inspection did not have a CFM certificate during the inspection. The CFM arrived at the end of the inspection. Ensure there are enough CFMs to cover all hours of food preparation and operation. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: Observed multiple soda nozzles on the soda machine to be soiled with accumulated soda debris and other debris. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned regularly and are maintained clean. Soda nozzles were pulled for cleaning during the inspection. 
(A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.112: Observed multiple dead cockroaches under the soda syrup in the dry storage area. Ensure that floors are cleaned routinely to avoid the attraction of pests, and to remove any dead pests in the facility. 
Dead or trapped birds, insects, rodents, and other pests shall be removed from control devices and the PREMISES at a frequency that prevents their accumulation, decomposition, or the attraction of pests.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: Observed the floors under the soda syrup and under the double door cooler to be soiled with soda syrup, food debris, and other debris. Ensure these areas are cleaned regularly. 
(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: Observed multiple wet mops to be stored in areas and positions that do not allow them to dry properly. One mop was inside a carboard box in the walk in display cooler, and one mop was sitting inside the mop bucket in a position that did not allow it to drip dry. Ensure mops are stored properly in a position that allows them to dry properly. 
After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.
